description: Change audio speed from 0.5× to 2× with real resampling and export as WAV.

faqs.a: The samples are resampled with linear interpolation, so pitch shifts naturally with speed, like a tape machine.
No — faster playback means higher pitch and shorter duration, exactly like speeding up a record.
A 16-bit PCM WAV; the result panel shows the new duration.

howto: Drop an audio file into the tool.
Drag the speed slider from 0.5× to 2×.
Click Download WAV to save it.
title: Audio Speed Changer
